name: fonts-paper
title: Gamestage fonts, paper
description: IBM Plex Sans for interface text and Instrument Serif for the numbers a player tracks, linked from Google Fonts. Neither is in the base pairing, so a paper install without this item renders in system-ui and Georgia. Installed for you by @gamestage/theme-paper.
docs: Import gamestage-fonts-paper.css once at the root, before gamestage-tokens.css, in place of gamestage-fonts.css. `font.import` is blank for the reason given on @gamestage/fonts.
